Ordinary weekend cheers for the gate crew
A month with shift swaps in mind
Calm handling, steady trips

This month at the Companion Animal Travel Desk, the team kept routine bookings moving with the same care they give every traveling pet. Staff checked crate notes, reviewed comfort plans, and stayed alert for small changes that can make a big difference for animals and their companions. The focus stayed on practical service, clear handoffs, and calm support at every step.

Aurelia Skyways wants dependable companion travel, and that means the desk keeps instructions simple and responses steady. Travelers should share updates early, keep documents ready, and follow handler guidance without delay. When the work stays organized, pets settle better and the whole journey feels smoother.
